# v2026.10.53-2

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.53-2.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.53-2.md).

This release covers **5 pull requests, with thanks to 2 contributors.**

## Highlights

- Issued invoices show their refusal reason and a link to a matched Xero invoice. ([#444](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/444)) Thanks [@RoboForgeBot](https://github.com/RoboForgeBot).
- Seazona discovery revisits earlier order dates without delaying today’s jobs. ([#455](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/455))
- A read field goes to the custom field of the same name; mark work system fields. ([#389](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/389)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Quieter Custom fields page (New button, no empty text or count). ([#409](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/409))

## Changes

- A read field goes to the custom field of the same name; mark work system fields. ([#389](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/389)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Quieter Custom fields page (New button, no empty text or count). ([#409](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/409))

## Fixes

- Seazona discovery revisits earlier order dates without delaying today’s jobs. ([#455](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/455))
- Issued invoices show their refusal reason and a link to a matched Xero invoice. ([#444](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/444)) Thanks [@RoboForgeBot](https://github.com/RoboForgeBot).
